Players Committee card image of [[Ability, Ability, Ability (V) (Virtual Set 0)]] (original printing), a retired Virtual Modern card (Virtual Set 0).

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/abilityabilityability.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). the file is still in the repository but no card uses it since the card was blanked (24 February 2021).

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
